ns2:course.label: Time Series Analysis in Econ
ns2:course.description: Modern time series analysis techniques for handling economic data which arises in a happenstance fashion through time and their application to specific economic problems. Prerequisite: ECON 503 or STAT 578, or equivalent. MSPE Graduate Student Standing.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ECON 503 or STAT 578, or equivalent. MSPE Graduate Student Standing.
